AAPL Stock Forecast for 2019
In 2018, even the most powerful and reliable tech stocks struggled. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL), long a dominant tech company with a sky-high market cap, impressive sales numbers, and internationally recognized brand that was second to none even felt the burn.
But this minor setback isn't enough to sway me off of Apple stock. My AAPL stock forecast for 2019 is that it could yield big gains in 2019 and for many years after that.
First, we have to establish what happened in 2018. Like many tech stocks, Apple started out strong in 2018, with a yearly high.
